reviews_5s:
Just the right size for my needs. I use it daily. The plastic is rigid. I like it better than silicone.I like to "marry product when I get to the last few ounces of it so this makes it easy to do soI sucked at pouring extra resin back into the bottle but now I don't. This little guy came to my rescue and now I am a pouring champion. You're welcome world!It does the job well when I’m filling my windshield fluid, but it’s a little overpricedThe funnel works fine, and is sturdy enough to hold the fluids that are transferred through it.Really like this funnel. Unfortunately for me, it's a bit smaller than I thought. My mistake, however.This is a sturdy, great quality kitchen funnel. I soon discovered my husband feels the same way! For months, I could not figure out what happened to my funnel, so I purchased a new one. The new one is collapsible and worked great until I washed it. It was then too lopsided to use.

Back to the husband and funnel…. As I was searching for an item in the garage, it occurred to me his oil draining funnels look almost identical to these funnels!! When I asked, “Honey, did you use my funnel in the garage?” His answer, “I don’t remember” almost always means “yes”. So much for that funnel’s usefulness in the kitchen!

In lieu of this, I would sure love to see these made in different colors lest my husband sneaks off with it again.😅I needed a small funnel for measuring liquids into containers. This workedI like the size of it, makes it convenient in my tight kitchen, and I can hang it on a hook under the cabinetperfect
